[name="凯尔希"]但是特蕾西娅和特雷西斯做到的事，让我确信了一点。
[name="凯尔希"]你对源石的控制并非无可动摇，依然存在一些手段来限制你对于源石的权限。
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_npc_1718_1#1$1")]
[name="普瑞赛斯"]你所说的两个人，我的确在源石内部见过他们。
[name="普瑞赛斯"]他们的努力的确出人意料，是令人惊喜的挣扎。

[name="普瑞赛斯"]可惜事实是，它们终究会经历绝望。
[name="普瑞赛斯"]“提卡兹”，你们本不在计划之中，却意外成为了对源石污染最为严重的物种。
[name="普瑞赛斯"]你站在这里，连我都不得不赞叹你们的勇气。
[name="特雷西斯"]“意外”……这就是你对我们命运的总结？
[name="特雷西斯"]你们的确很像，普瑞赛斯。
[name="特雷西斯"]将被你们肆意玩弄的命运称作希望的馈赠，将绵延万年的苦痛视为理所应当的牺牲。
[name="特雷西斯"]……但至少，{@nickname}比你更加坦诚。
[dialog]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_swrdgnlght", volume=1)]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_tswordlight", volume=1)]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0, block=true)]
[Blocker(a=1, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0.5, block=true)]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_erthshkng", volume=1, loop=true, channel="e")]
[StopSound(channel="e", fadetime=6)]
[charslot]
[Background]
[image]
他的长剑刺破了虚妄，但破碎后的空间——
[dialog]
[avgdisplay(id = "1", style = "bgeffect", name = "$eb_glow_l", slot = "bgover", x=-425, y=20, layer = 5)]
[Background(image="60_g5_rhodesabyss_c",screenadapt="coverall")]
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_npc_1297_1#4$1")]
[Delay(time=1)]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=2, block=true)]
[Delay(time=1)]
[name="特雷西斯"]……没有变化？
[charslot]
特雷西斯闭上了眼，抬起了手中剑。
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_npc_1718_1#1$1")]
[name="普瑞赛斯"]你的暴力毫无意义。
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_npc_1297_1#1$1")]
[name="特雷西斯"]如果你并不在乎我们这个可悲的种族是否能抓住自己的命运，那你早该干脆利落地抹除我。
[name="特雷西斯"]刚刚从长梦中苏醒的幽灵，你仍然很虚弱，对吗？
[dialog]
[charslot(duration=0.5)]
[Blocker(a=0, r=255,g=255, b=255, fadetime=0, block=true)]
[Blocker(a=1, r=255,g=255, b=255, fadetime=0.03, block=true)]
[CameraShake(duration=0.5, xstrength=40, ystrength=40, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[PlaySound(key="$e_skill_skulsrsword", volume=1)]
[Blocker(a=0, r=255,g=255, b=255, fadetime=0.5, block=true)]
他毫不犹豫地挥出了手中剑。
剑光穿过了眼前之人的身体，无声地消失在远方苍白的墙面上。
[dialog]
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_npc_1718_1#8$1", duration=0.5, isblock=true)]
[name="普瑞赛斯"]我说过，这并无意义。
[dialog]
[charslot(duration=0.5)]
[Blocker(a=0, r=255,g=255, b=255, fadetime=0, block=true)]
[Blocker(a=1, r=255,g=255, b=255, fadetime=0.03, block=true)]
[CameraShake(duration=0.5, xstrength=40, ystrength=40, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[PlaySound(key="$e_skill_skulsrsword", volume=1)]
[Blocker(a=0, r=255,g=255, b=255, fadetime=0.5, block=true)]
又是一剑。
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_npc_1297_1#4$1")]
[name="特雷西斯"]我一直有一个疑问——自诩造物主的你们，到底与我们有何异？
[dialog]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_clothmovement", volume=1)]
[charslot(slot = "m", action="zoom", poszoom = "0.5,0.5", scale=1.05, duration = 0.2)]
[charslot(duration=0.2)]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0, block=true)]
[Blocker(a=1, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0.2, block=true)]
[avgdisplay(id = "1")]
[Background]
[PlaySound(key="$swordtsing3", volume=1)]
[Effect(name="$e_spark_01_large",layer=2)]
[Blocker(a=1, r=255, g=255, b=255, fadetime=0.01, block=true)]
[Blocker(a=0, r=255, g=255, b=255, fadetime=1, block=false)]
[Effect(name="$e_bladeline_01_large",x =116.1, y =0,rox =-60.2, roy =145, roz =16, layer = 1)]
[delay(time=0.4)]
[PlaySound(key="$swordtsing4", volume=1)]
[Blocker(a=1, r=255, g=255, b=255, fadetime=0.01, block=true)]
[Blocker(a=0, r=255, g=255, b=255, fadetime=1, block=false)]
[Effect(name="$e_bladeline_01_large",x =120.1, y =-103.4,rox =-60.2, roy =145, roz =16,  layer = 1)]
[delay(time=0.6)]
[PlaySound(key="$swordtsing5", volume=0.4)]
[PlaySound(key="$e_skill_skulsrsword", volume=1)]
[Effect(name="$e_bladeline_01_large",x =-141.8, y =-211.64,rox =30.5, roy =105.1, roz =39, layer = 1)]
[Effect(name="$e_spark_01_mid",x =-141.8, y =-211.64,rox =50, roy =100, roz =50, layer = 1)]
[Effect(name="$e_spark_02_mid",x =-141.8, y =-211.64,rox =100, roy =100, roz =50, layer = 1)]
[Effect(name="$e_spark_01_mid",x =-141.8, y =-211.64,rox =100, roy =100, roz =50, layer = 1)]
[PlaySound(key="$d_gen_surfacefrozen", volume=1, loop=true, channel="s")]
[StopSound(channel="s", fadetime=6)]
[Background(image="60_g5_rhodesabyss_c",screenadapt="coverall")]
[avgdisplay(id = "1", style = "bgeffect", name = "$eb_glow_l", slot = "bgover", x=-425, y=20, layer = 5)]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=1.5, block=true)]
特雷西斯不再有任何的保留，苍白的墙面已经出现了裂纹。
[dialog]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_sea", volume=0, loop=true, channel="sea")]
[SoundVolume(volume=0.4, channel="sea", fadetime=2)]
[delay(time=2)]
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_npc_1297_1#1$1")]
[name="特雷西斯"]你并非静滞了一切。
[name="特雷西斯"]你想要拖延时间，又或者只是为了嘲弄一个可悲种族的挣扎……
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_npc_1297_1#4$1")]
[name="特雷西斯"]随便你，普瑞赛斯。
[dialog]
[charslot]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_erthshkng", volume=1, loop=true, channel="e")]
[CameraShake(duration=4, xstrength=5, ystrength=5, vibrato=90, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[StopSound(channel="e", fadetime=4)]
[delay(time=2)]
特雷西斯再次感受到了涌动的信息浪潮，那是特蕾西娅所编织的高塔破碎后的残余。
特雷西斯挥出了下一剑。
[dialog]
[Blocker(a=0, r=255,g=255, b=255, fadetime=0, block=true)]
[Blocker(a=1, r=255,g=255, b=255, fadetime=0.03, block=true)]
[CameraShake(duration=0.5, xstrength=40, ystrength=40, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_swrdgnlght", volume=1)]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_tswordlight", volume=1)]
[Blocker(a=0, r=255,g=255, b=255, fadetime=0.5, block=true)]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_seawaterinflux", volume=1)]
[Delay(time=1)]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_seacitysurface", volume=1)]
[Delay(time=0.5)]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_mnwtrfll", volume=0.4, loop=true, channel="mn")]
金色的海水彻底冲破了苍白的墙壁，疯狂地涌入这片仿佛没有边际的白色空间。
浪潮迅速吞噬摧毁着目之所及的一切，却唯独被普瑞赛斯的身体挡住，切割……
就像一道彗星的黑色尾巴，在狂暴的浪涌中留下了最后一块宁静的地块。
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_npc_1297_1#1$1")]
[name="特雷西斯"]你和这枚源石的联系正在减弱，你在消散。
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_npc_1718_1#1$1")]
[name="普瑞赛斯"]继续处理这些杂乱的信息会消耗更多的必要能源，这并不值得。
[dialog]
[charslot]
[SoundVolume(volume=1, channel="mn",fadetime=2)]
[Delay(time=1)]
浪潮开始向最后一块区域合拢，普瑞赛斯的身体也逐渐被淹没。
水浪也逐渐漫向了特雷西斯。
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_npc_1718_1#2$1")]
[name="普瑞赛斯"]这是你想要的结局吗？
[name="普瑞赛斯"]萨卡兹的数据已经污染了内化宇宙中的部分区域。虽然那些数据都被删除了，但被改写的架构我暂时也无暇调整。
[name="普瑞赛斯"]你完全可以用另一种方式“存活”于内化宇宙之中。
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_npc_1297_1#4$1")]
[name="特雷西斯"]存活？
[name="特雷西斯"]我只为审判神明而来。
[charslot(slot = "m", focus="n")]
在信息的洪流彻底吞噬特雷西斯前，萨卡兹向造物主挥出了他的最后一剑。
